selected_script.angle: Curiosity and satisfying debris reveal in a top-loader
selected_script.hook: Ever wonder what's floating around in your top-loader while it runs?

script_record.segment_01_vo: Ever wonder what's floating around in your top-loader while it runs? I tossed this little floating net in my laundry today.
script_record.segment_02_vo: It just floats right on top of the water. The blue domes keep it up, while this long cone mesh catches hair, lint, and loose debris.
script_record.segment_03_vo: Look at what it caught after just one cycle! My dark clothes come out so much cleaner now. Just empty it, rinse, and reuse.

00:00-00:00.5，[特写镜头]，[打开波轮洗衣机盖子，水面有些许泡沫]。
00:00.5-00:01.0，[主观镜头]，[看向洗衣机内部正在搅拌的水流]。
00:01.0-00:01.5，[特写镜头]，[一只手拿着单只漂浮过滤网袋出现]。
00:01.5-00:03.0，[中景镜头]，[达人面对镜头说话，表情好奇，手持产品]。
00:03.0-00:06.0，[特写镜头]，[将单只过滤网袋轻轻扔进有衣物和水的洗衣机里]。
00:06.0-00:10.0，[特写镜头]，[过滤网袋在水面上平稳漂浮，蓝色的四个浮球在水面上，白色的锥形网袋在水下]。
